processTree.note: Sampled CPU is a lower bound: short-lived workers and final intervals can be missed. Summed RSS counts shared pages in each process. Use driver phase CPU and resource high-water RSS for exact single-process totals.

processMeasurement.note: wait4 CPU includes the command and descendants it waited for. maxRSS is the largest process high-water mark, not concurrent family RSS. Concurrent family RSS is sampled and counts shared pages repeatedly. Native driver records exact root peak RSS through close. No execution timeout: use only for authorized complete repository gates.

cumulative.note: Position/code/multiplicity parity for the historical cumulative source-diagnostic contracts, with retained reporter cuts recorded in the oracle. Complete latest-ten DTO/configuration parity is a separate required gate. Repository measured phases are listed explicitly. An empty incrementalDifferences array does not establish unmeasured full-repository edit parity. Persistent lifecycle tests are a separate gate. Compile, host preparation, and cold phases are separate; process CPU includes waited-for Python producers.

repositoryRevalidation.note: The historical joint 100-rule measurement is unchanged. Only changed rules were rerun over its entire file domain. These are separate executions; their timings cannot be combined into a new 100-rule measurement. Parent CPU excludes producer processes. Positive detection is covered by the fresh source-backed regression corpus.
